events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the 35th anniversary of the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost him, Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen track?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965, a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Vibe
angles.copy: 'Rubber Soul' dropped on this day in '65, changing everything. Which track from the album still hits different for you?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day, we remember John Lennon, who tragically passed away in 1980 and would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Lennon's Impact
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon today, an artist whose music and message continue to resonate. What's his most iconic song for you?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Today would have been the 80th birthday of the iconic musician and innovator, David Bowie.

angles.name: Bowie's Legacy
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible artistry of David Bowie on what would have been his 80th birthday. A true visionary.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're still all shook up for Elvis Presley. The King lives on!

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the maestro himself, Jimmy Page! His riffs are still legendary.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The legendary rocker Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod The Mod
angles.copy: Raise a glass for Sir Rod Stewart, turning 82 today! Still got that distinctive voice.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs from Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Madness Frontman
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the one and only Suggs! Still bringing the house of fun.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English pop singer Paul Young, known for hits like "Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)", celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Paul's Smooth Vocals
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! Those smooth 80s vocals are still gold.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: The legendary country music icon Dolly Parton would have celebrated her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible Dolly Parton on what would have been her 81st birthday. An absolute treasure.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and successful solo artist Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary's Tunes
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! A true pop songwriting legend, from Take That to his solo success.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: British soul singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 77th birthday to Billy Ocean! His hits still make us want to get outta our dreams.

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame's Inaugural Ceremony
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place, honouring pioneers like The Beatles, Elvis Presley, and Chuck Berry.

angles.name: Hall Of Fame History
angles.copy: Remembering the very first Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony today. Who was your favourite from that inaugural class?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! Still charming the nation after all these years with Take That.

events.title: The Beatles' Iconic Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final public concert on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Get Back To The Rooftop
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles played their iconic rooftop concert. Imagine being there!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: The legendary Genesis drummer and solo artist Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: In The Air Tonight
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the incredible Phil Collins! A true musical powerhouse.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Celebrated British actor Hugh Grant, known for his roles in romantic comedies, celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Grant's Charm
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the ever-charming Hugh Grant! Always a national treasure.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar, actor, and former *NSYNC member Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: JT's Big Day
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to Justin Timberlake! From boy band heartthrob to solo sensation, he's still bringing the moves.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: National treasure Sir David Jason, beloved for roles in Only Fools and Horses and A Touch of Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly!
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary Sir David Jason! A true icon of British television.

events.title: Remembering 'The Day The Music Died'
events.blurb: Today marks the tragic anniversary of 'The Day The Music Died' in 1959, when Buddy Holly (who would have been 91), Ritchie Valens (who would have been 86), and The Big Bopper (who would have been 97) lost their lives in a plane crash.

angles.name: A Tragic Loss
angles.copy: On this day in 1959, music lost three stars. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Pop icon Rick Astley, famous for "Never Gonna Give You Up" and his recent resurgence, celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to Rick Astley! Still got that infectious charm and timeless hits.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: The legendary reggae pioneer Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Marley's Message
angles.copy: On what would have been his 82nd birthday, we honour the enduring spirit and music of Bob Marley. One love.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Acclaimed singer-songwriter Carole King, known for her seminal album 'Tapestry', celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Tapestry of Hits
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the legendary Carole King! Her songs are the soundtrack to so many lives.

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of the incomparable vocal talent, Whitney Houston, who would have been 64 this year.

angles.name: The Voice
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Whitney Houston today. Her voice was pure magic.

events.title: Take That's Original Split Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, the UK was in mourning as pop giants Take That announced their initial split.

angles.name: The Day The Fans Cried
angles.copy: Twenty-one years ago today, Take That broke hearts with their split. Thankfully, they got back for good!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: The distinctive voice of UB40, Ali Campbell, celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Red Red Wine
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell! Still bringing those reggae vibes with UB40.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global superstar Ed Sheeran celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: Shape Of You
angles.copy: Happy 36th birthday to Ed Sheeran! Still crafting those incredible tunes that dominate the charts.

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: Today would have been the 84th birthday of The Beatles' 'Quiet Beatle', George Harrison.

angles.name: All Things Must Pass
angles.copy: On what would have been his 84th birthday, we remember the incredible George Harrison. His music continues to shine.
